vulnerable_code:
class WebhookEndpointPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  def trigger_test?
    # Checks user existence and endpoint active flag, but omits organization matching
    user.present? && record.active?
  end
end

class Api::WebhooksController < ApplicationController
  def test_dispatch
    @endpoint = WebhookEndpoint.find(params[:id])
    authorize @endpoint, :trigger_test?

    WebhookDispatchWorker.perform_async(@endpoint.id, params[:sample_payload])
    render json: { message: 'Test webhook enqueued' }, status: :accepted
  end
end
diagnosis: WebhookEndpointPolicy#trigger_test? confirms user presence and endpoint active status without ensuring the webhook endpoint belongs to current_user's organization. Attackers can trigger replay events and send attacker-specified payloads to external integration endpoints configured by other organizations.

corrected_code:
class WebhookEndpointPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  def trigger_test?
    return false unless user.present? && record.active?
    record.organization_id == user.organization_id
  end
end

class Api::WebhooksController < ApplicationController
  def test_dispatch
    @endpoint = WebhookEndpoint.find(params[:id])
    authorize @endpoint, :trigger_test?

    WebhookDispatchWorker.perform_async(@endpoint.id, params[:sample_payload])
    render json: { message: 'Test webhook enqueued' }, status: :accepted
  end
end
